acceptanceCriteria.text: Linux rollback directories retain owner search and execute permission, nested restoration reproduces file contents and mode, and all mutations remain contained.
Physical workspace identity resolution completes within a finite bound on Windows and non-Windows without caller-thread blocking, cancellation gaps, abandoned workers, or silent platform returns.
SQLite connection opening is finitely bounded before native-handle publication on every supported platform and leaves no worker, handle, callback, interrupt, pool, or lifecycle leak.
Only outcomes precisely attributable to requested cancellation become OperationCanceledException; independent I/O, disposal, and provider failures retain their original type and details.
Repository and Agent Help fixtures discover their root from true external deterministic builds with mapped CallerFilePath and no MCP_REPOSITORY_ROOT override.

Every supported platform executes an applicable native contract assertion in the integration lane: platform-specific tests are Category=Integration tests, tagged Platform=Linux or Platform=Windows when they apply to one host, that run in their host's MigrationIntegrationTests (TR-MCP-NUKE-019) and neither skip nor silently return; no unit test depends on the platform or on the process environment, directly, through a test helper or through the production code it calls: a test whose outcome can change with the value of an environment variable it reads or writes, directly, through a test helper or through the production code it calls (for example a temporary-folder lookup that takes its folder from a variable and creates it), a test that imports the process environment into configuration (AddEnvironmentVariables or a default host builder), and a test that asserts on an environment value a child process inherits are Category=Integration tests that set and restore every variable their assertions or the code they call depend on, every name of a fallback chain the code reads, both forms where a variable has a canonical (QBrainAi, QBRAINAI_) and a legacy (Mcp, MCP_) form, and the tests that write the process environment run one at a time; a unit test may reach production code that reads an environment variable only where the hostile-environment gate shows its outcome does not change, and one safe value passing does not show that: the full unit suite stays 0 failed and 0 not executed under that gate, which sets every variable a unit test names or the production code reads to a scripted hostile value and runs once with each folder variable at a test-owned folder, once with each folder variable at the path of a test-owned regular file, once each with every numeric variable at 0, at the largest and at the smallest 32-bit integer, and once with the time zone and culture (TZ, LANG and LC_ALL) set to values the build host does not use, leaving only PATH, TMPDIR, NUGET_PACKAGES, DOTNET_CLI_HOME and a scripted HOME usable for the build, with XDG_DATA_HOME unset so that it follows the scripted HOME (operator 2026-10-21: "Fix both, strengthen ACs", "Strengthening Acceptance Criteria should always be the recommended option" and "Approve, strengthen AC-006/008 (Recommended)"; operator 2026-10-26: "Strengthen AC, move 14 (Recommended)", "Dependence + proof AC (Recommended)" and "Fix source, strengthen AC (Recommended)"; hostile validation findings R5-F2, R6-F1 and R7-F1).

The rejected fourteenth receipt is preserved with an explicit supersession notice, and the fifteenth evidence records every failed, inconclusive, and passing run with independently verified hashes and command mappings.

result.title: Cross-platform bounded native I/O and deterministic evidence
result.description:
Use searchable Linux directory modes and descriptor-relative restoration. Isolate potentially blocking physical identity and SQLite pre-handle opens behind finitely owned platform cancellation mechanisms. Classify cancellation from direct operation evidence, and resolve repository fixtures from deterministic assembly metadata rather than mapped caller paths.
Converted from FR-MCP-USECASE-016 on 2026-10-19 (operator: "If it is in a FR, then that FR needs to be converted to a TR"; answers "Merge into its TR (Recommended)" and "FR-001, delete FRs (Recommended)"). FR-MCP-USECASE-016 stated: Use-case persistence and its supporting contained rollback, physical workspace identity, SQLite opening, cancellation classification, and repository evidence paths shall remain safe and finitely completing on every supported platform, including deterministic CI builds, while preserving exact provider failures and truthful supersession evidence.
**Covered by:** FR: FR-MCP-USECASE-001; TEST: TEST-MCP-USECASE-019
